newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AGRICULTURAL BANK APPROVES SHARE CAPITAL BOOST.
newsitem.headline: AGRICULTURAL BANK APPROVES SHARE CAPITAL BOOST.

text.p: Lithuania's huge state-run Agricultural Bank said on Monday that its council had approved a board proposal to raise its share capital by 55 million litas to 183 million litas.

A spokeswoman for the bank told Reuters that the move was necessary to improve the bank's capital adequacy ratio, which was 9.18 percent as of May 1. The Bank of Lithuania's minimum requirement is ten percent.
"How the share capital will be increased is to be decided at the gneral shareholders' meeting on June 6," she added.
The bank, which is 86 percent state-owned, is Lithuania's largest bank in terms of assets and has been slated for privatisation.
It posted a net profit of 25.5 million litas in 1996 compared to 26.5 million litas in 1995. Its 1997 first quarter profit was 11.24 million litas.
